changelog: Dual Connection (Hotspot vs Wi-Fi) & 60 FPS Hardware MJPEG Fix: 1) Added Dual Connection support: Direct Mobile Hotspot (bypasses router network congestion) and Local Wi-Fi Router. 2) Fixed UVC hardware frame rate throttle (now unlocks full 60 FPS hardware MJPEG instead of defaulting to 5-10 FPS). 3) Detached competing surfaces and MediaCodec from UVC pipeline so 100% of frames stream to WebRTC without vsync lock.
